eval: (() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; if (!game.debug) throw new Error('golden-frame needs the dev hooks (a dev server, or a build with ?debug=1)'); const { ctx, state } = game; const canvas = ctx.renderer.domElement; for (const element of document.body.querySelectorAll('*')) { if (element !== canvas && !element.contains(canvas)) element.style.visibility = 'hidden'; } game.debug.pauseLoop(); state.paused = true; const spawn = state.spawn; ctx.systems.flight.resetTo({ x: spawn.x, y: spawn.y, z: spawn.z, heading: spawn.heading }); game.debug.stepFrames(30); return JSON.stringify({ paused: true, spawn: { x: Math.round(spawn.x), y: Math.round(spawn.y), z: Math.round(spawn.z), heading: Math.round(spawn.heading) } }); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; game.debug.stepFrames(30); const weather = game.ctx.systems.weather; const sky = game.ctx.systems.sky; return JSON.stringify({ frame: game.frame, weather: weather && weather.getState ? weather.getState().state : 'no weather system', modifiers: sky.getModifierState ? sky.getModifierState() : 'no sky modifiers', terrainPending: game.ctx.systems.terrain.getStats().pending }); })()
(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; game.debug.stepFrames(10); return `frame ${game.frame}, the same paused scene again`; })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const weather = game.ctx.systems.weather; if (weather && weather.dispose) weather.dispose(); game.debug.stepFrames(10); const sky = game.ctx.systems.sky; return JSON.stringify({ frame: game.frame, weatherDisposed: Boolean(weather && weather.dispose), modifiers: sky.getModifierState ? sky.getModifierState() : 'no sky modifiers' }); })()
